Topic: Foundations of Linear Algebra: From Span to Basis

Target audience: Undergraduate students in STEM

Section: section_1 — Prerequisite Intuition: The Vector Space

Lecture lines:
Vectors are arrows in 2D space.
Scaling changes vector magnitude.
Adding vectors shifts positions.

Planned animations:
Create 2D vector 'v' in color #FF5733 appearing from origin.
Label vector 'v' with text "v" in color #FF5733 near the head.
Show scalar multiplication 2*v by scaling vector 'v' to double length.

Section: section_2 — Linear Combinations and Span

Lecture lines:
Linear combinations scale and add vectors.
Span is every reachable destination.
Varied factors create a grid.

Planned animations:
Display vectors 'u' (#33FF57) and 'v' (#3357FF) on screen.
Visualize the parallelogram sum u+v with dotted lines (#FFFFFF).
Highlight the resultant vector w = u+v in color #FFFF33.

Section: section_3 — Linear Dependence: Redundancy

Lecture lines:
Dependence reveals redundant directions.
A third vector adds no reach.
Like hikers following one trail.

Planned animations:
Show three vectors 'u', 'v', 'w' where w = u + v.
Fade out vector 'w' to demonstrate it is redundant.
Flash vectors 'u' and 'v' to show independence.

Section: section_4 — Basis: The Minimalist Framework

Lecture lines:
Basis is the minimal span set.
It removes all redundant vectors.
Basis acts as coordinate frames.

Planned animations:
Display a set of basis vectors 'i' (#FF33FF) and 'j' (#33FFFF).
Show vector 'v' as a grid combination of 'i' and 'j'.
Highlight the grid lines to emphasize the spanning property.

Section: section_5 — Synthesis and Summary

Lecture lines:
Span defines your total reach.
Dependence marks redundant paths.
Basis builds the perfect frame.

Planned animations:
Assemble vectors, combinations, and basis into a central triangle (#FFFFFF).
Flash each vertex to connect Spanning, Dependence, and Basis.
Fade all components together to show the unified framework.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        self.wait(1)

        self.play(Indicate(u), Indicate(v))

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        self.setup_layout("Synthesis and Summary", [
            "Span defines your total reach.", 
            "Dependence marks redundant paths.", 
            "Basis builds the perfect frame."
        ])
        
        # Setup visualization objects
        triangle = Polygon(ORIGIN, RIGHT*2 + UP*1.5, RIGHT*4, color=WHITE)
        span_dot = Dot(triangle.get_vertices()[0], color=BLUE)
        dep_dot = Dot(triangle.get_vertices()[1], color=RED)
        basis_dot = Dot(triangle.get_vertices()[2], color=GREEN)
        
        frame = VGroup(triangle, span_dot, dep_dot, basis_dot)
        self.place_in_area(frame, 'B2', 'E5', scale_factor=0.8)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(Create(frame), run_time=1)
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(BLUE))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(Indicate(dep_dot), run_time=1)
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(RED))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(Indicate(basis_dot), run_time=1)
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(GREEN))
        self.play(FadeOut(frame), run_time=1)
